guidance.bestFor: An @ prefix and a fixed mail domain suffix on profile inputs, with a required star and a green available hint
agentNotes: The invalid email `Field` keeps a muted `FieldDescription` for its message; swap in `FieldError` so the text reads red
Username is available is fixed text in a green `FieldDescription`; drive it from your own availability check

whenNotToUse.when: Error messages printed in red under each input that failed

guidance.bestFor: A support ticket subject and message, with a character count set at the right end of the message label row
agentNotes: The 0/500 count beside `FieldLabel` is static text; compute it from the `Textarea` value and cap the length to match

whenNotToUse.when: A one time security code typed into separate digit boxes

guidance.bestFor: Plan and billing cycle dropdowns that load set to the pro plan and yearly billing, each with a hint below
agentNotes: On the base twin the triggers show the raw values pro and yearly; give `Select` an items map from value to label to show the labels

whenNotToUse.when: A dropdown whose options carry icons, avatars, badges or a description each

name: c-field-4
title: Field with radio groups and checkboxes
label: Radio & Checkboxes
description: Field with radio groups and checkboxes

guidance.bestFor: Email opt-in checkboxes with one locked on, then a public or private radio choice, each under its own legend

whenNotToUse.when: Delivery channels flipped on and off by switches, not ticked

guidance.bestFor: A switch at the end of a titled row, then a slider in steps of 5 whose live percent reads beside its label
agentNotes: `cpuLimit` keeps the slider value in local state only, seeded at 75; save it from `onValueChange`

whenNotToUse.when: A range with 2 thumbs or tick marks under the track

guidance.bestFor: A native select of delivery methods above a 6 slot code split 3 and 3 by a separator
agentNotes: `NativeSelect` and `InputOTP` have no handlers, so send the code by the picked method and check the 6 digits yourself

whenNotToUse.when: A code entry on its own, with no delivery method picker above it

guidance.bestFor: A long profile settings column mixing a slug error, a bio counter, 2 email switches and a terms checkbox above Save
agentNotes: Save Changes is a `Button` outside any form element with no handler, so nothing is sent
The slug `FieldError` text and `data-invalid` are fixed; set both from your slug check result
The 24/160 bio count is static and does not match the default text; compute it from the `Textarea` value

whenNotToUse.when: A sign up whose password fails a list of rules under one input

guidance.bestFor: Role access levels from read to admin as ticked rows, with the owner only level disabled and a hint under the legend
agentNotes: Write claims to require Read, yet clearing `perm-read` leaves `perm-write` ticked; enforce the dependency in your handler

guidance.bestFor: A member invite whose labels sit beside the inputs on a wide container and stack above them when narrow
agentNotes: `orientation` responsive follows the width of the enclosing `FieldGroup`, not the viewport, so keep each `Field` inside one
On the base twin the role trigger shows the raw value member; give `Select` an items map so it shows the label

guidance.bestFor: Delivery channels as switch rows and event types as checkbox rows, in 2 legend groups split by a separator
A sign up with icon addons where the password fails 2 rules, passed as an errors array and shown as bullets
agentNotes: Pass your validator issues to `FieldError` through `errors`; only entries with a `message` show, and a repeated message shows once
`data-invalid` and both `FieldError` messages are hardcoded beside the `defaultValue` text; set them from your validation result

whenNotToUse.when: Errors inside a longer settings page with switches and a terms checkbox
